sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Unsloth lets you run and fine-tune AI models on your own computer. It comes as a desktop app, a web UI called Unsloth Studio, and Unsloth Core, a Python library that trains models faster and with less GPU memory.
sixtySeconds.problem: Fine-tuning language models usually needs big GPUs and a lot of setup. Unsloth's optimised training uses less memory, so models can be trained on consumer GPUs or free Colab notebooks, and its apps also run models locally.
whoFor: People fine-tuning open models on their own data
Developers running local models for Claude Code or Codex
Researchers doing LoRA, QLoRA or reinforcement learning
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for fast, memory-efficient fine-tuning plus an easy app to run local models. The README claims 2x faster training with 70% less VRAM; results vary by model and setup.
requirements: A GPU helps (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) but CPUs are supported
For Unsloth Core: Python 3.13 and uv

overview: Unsloth comes in three forms. Unsloth Desktop is a native app for Windows, macOS and Linux. Unsloth Studio is a web UI you install with a script, Homebrew or Docker and start with unsloth studio. Unsloth Core is the code-based Python package for training in your own scripts.

For running models, it supports LLM, GGUF, MLX, diffusion, embedding and audio models, serves them through an OpenAI-compatible API, and can connect local models to Claude Code, Codex and other agents with unsloth start. It includes web search, RAG, sandboxing for commands models run, and LAN or remote access.

For training, it supports LoRA, QLoRA, full fine-tuning, pretraining and reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO and DPO, plus FP8, and exports to formats like GGUF. Free Colab notebooks cover models like Llama, Qwen, Gemma and gpt-oss.

install.verificationNote: Commands come from Unsloth's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

steps.title: Install with PowerShell
steps.body: If endpoint protection blocks this, use winget install --id UnslothAI.Unsloth -e.

steps.title: Create an environment and install
steps.code:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
uv venv unsloth_env --python 3.13
source unsloth_env/bin/activate
uv pip install unsloth --torch-backend=auto

troubleshooting.problem: irm | iex blocked on a managed Windows PC
Windows Core install resolves an old Unsloth
troubleshooting.solution: Install torchao first, then uv pip install unsloth --torch-backend=auto.
Set UNSLOTH_DESKTOP_PORT (1024 to 65515) and fully restart the app.
Follow the matching guide linked in the README.
